```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(qss)
```

# Load and inspect

```{r}
data("UNpop", package = "qss")
class(UNpop)
names(UNpop)
dim(UNpop)
summary(UNpop)

UNpop <- as_tibble(UNpop)
UNpop

UNpop$world.pop
UNpop[1:3, ]
```

**Interpret:** Each row is a **year** (unit of analysis). Columns are **variables**.

# Tidyverse summaries

```{r}
UNpop <- UNpop |>
  mutate(
    world.pop.millions = world.pop / 1000,
    decade_index = row_number()
  )

UNpop |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_pop = mean(world.pop),
    min_year = min(year),
    max_year = max(year)
  )

UNpop |>
  arrange(year) |>
  mutate(
    pop_increase = world.pop - lag(world.pop),
    percent_increase = 100 * pop_increase / lag(world.pop)
  )
```

**Interpret:** These are descriptive summaries of population change over decades — still not causal.
